text_block_list.text:

refresh yourself over the break?

text_block_list.text:

Hair and tail properly cared for and silky 
smooth♪

so nicely?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's what a first-rate performance feels 
like♪ Right!
